_note: Candy Miner wording for everything the game shows (quests, dialogue, equipment names and blurbs, workers, boosts, HQ research and floors, stage names, ore names). The game data in src/data/game carries no original text: these are the only strings. Names follow docs/CANDY.md. Keys: quest / dialogue / worker / boost / HQ floor / HQ research ids, equipment and upgrade keys, stage order, ore keys (`ores`: display name per ore key). Dialogue keeps each entry's line count: Game slices some of them by position.

101: Baron Sourpuss froze Candy Valley into blocks, sweetie! Grab your Candy Pick and set the candy free.
102: Yummy load! Raw candy won't sell, though. Drop it on COOK at the factory to make treats.
201: Look at all that cash, sweetie! Let's spend some at the Upgrade Kitchen. Better tools, more candy, one grumpy Baron!
301: You've got enough for a new tool. To the Garage we go!
302: Hand tools are yours to keep. Machines are rent-only.
401: Shiny new tool! Anything you buy here stays yours for good.
Tap EQUIPMENT any time you want to switch tools.
501: Rented! It's yours for this land. In the next land, you rent again.
It's parked by the factory already. Go take a peek!
502: Look at you in the driver's seat! Smooth moves, sweetie.
Getting out is easy too. Just tap the exit button.
One catch: that button only pops up once you've stopped.
Granny's safety rule number one: full stop before you hop out!
601: Uh-oh, the syrup tank's empty! Without syrup it can only crawl.
Until you rent a Syrup Tanker, carry syrup jars over from the Syrup Pump. Go fill it up!
801: Welcome to Candy HQ! Look outside: this land has its colours back, thanks to you!
While you're here, let's power up your hand tools. Follow me!
This is the Tool Workshop. Pop in often to make your tools stronger!
802: Tour done! Ready to free the next land from the Baron's sour spell?
803: Great news: the Machine Bay is open! Can you pop over to HQ for a sec?
This is where you research upgrades for your machines.
Machine research works a little differently: it costs Gear. Want to try it?
The HQ button is up in the corner. Tap it whenever you're ready!
804: The factory is humming again! Hi, I'm Coco, I keep things running here.
Sorry to butt in! Swing by Candy HQ when you're done. I'll be here.
901: Too much candy for one Boss? Time to build a crew!
Job applications pop in every so often. Don't leave them waiting!
I baked a few favours: your first hire is free. Sign right here!
Your crew works on their own until the land is free, and they can borrow your hand tools too!
When you're set, swing by the Crew Cottage and I'll show you around!
902: Welcome to the Crew Cottage! Keep an eye on your team here.
Best part? Your crew can borrow your hand tools. Let me show you.
Everyone starts with basic tools. Slot yours in and they'll put them to work!
Empty slot? Tap Equip. Taken? Swap it. You can grab it back whenever you need it!
Your toolbox is still small, but this pays off later. Back to work, sweetie!
903: Tired crew head to the Picnic Café next door: a snack, a drink or a nap gets their energy back.
Throw them a CREW PICNIC now and then. It keeps everyone going.
Big crew? Add more tables. No seat means no proper rest!
1101: You freed enough candy to clear this land! Look, the colours are coming back!
Heads up: that's only the minimum. The Baron hates it when we're thorough!
You can move on now, but turning your leftover candy into cash first really pays. Your call!
1201: Great news, Boss! Our suppliers are giving us cashback now!
Sweet, right? The more you spend, the more comes back!
Tools, hires, upgrades: hit each target and the reward is yours!
1501: Grab syrup jars at the Syrup Pump. Spare jars go in the jar bin right here.
1601: Granny's tip, sweetie: once you're breaking candy, just let go.
You'll stroll to the next block nearby and keep smashing on your own.
